title: Structure your Seedance prompt as a timecoded shot list (e.g., 0:00–0:15) to…
content:
Structure your Seedance prompt as a timecoded shot list (e.g., 0:00–0:15) to force clear beat-by-beat action progression and reduce drift.

Use an uploaded character sheet and explicitly say “strict visual reference” to lock character identity and consistency across the clip.

Specify clip length up front (e.g., 15 seconds) to constrain pacing and prevent the model from stretching or compressing the sequence.

Define camera language per beat (wide/close/low-angle/tracking) and add “camera angles switching rapidly…never staying on one angle more than one second” to drive fast-cut editing.

Call out environment props as usable tools/weapons (bamboo poles, cement bags, ladders, rope pulleys, paint buckets, planks) to prompt grounded, readable fight choreography.

For audio-driven edits, instruct “music from frame one never stopping” and “every impact synced to the beat” to align hits, cuts, and sound effects to rhythm.

Lock the visual style with stacked render keywords (cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime, semi-realistic CGI, hand-painted textures, Unreal Engine quality, film grain, hard-edge brushwork, heavy shadows) and include explicit negatives (not cartoon, not Disney, not Pixar) to avoid style drift.

es.content:
Estructura tu prompt de Seedance como una lista de planos con marcas de tiempo (por ejemplo, 0:00–0:15) para forzar una progresión clara de la acción, beat por beat, y reducir la deriva.

Usa una hoja de personaje subida y di explícitamente “strict visual reference” para fijar la identidad del personaje y la coherencia a lo largo del clip.

Especifica la duración del clip desde el principio (por ejemplo, 15 segundos) para limitar el ritmo y evitar que el modelo estire o comprima la secuencia.

Define el lenguaje de cámara por beat (wide/close/low-angle/tracking) y añade “camera angles switching rapidly…never staying on one angle more than one second” para impulsar una edición de cortes rápidos.

Menciona los elementos del entorno como herramientas/armas utilizables (bamboo poles, cement bags, ladders, rope pulleys, paint buckets, planks) para generar una coreografía de combate sólida y fácil de leer.

Para ediciones impulsadas por audio, indica “music from frame one never stopping” y “every impact synced to the beat” para alinear golpes, cortes y efectos de sonido con el ritmo.

Bloquea el estilo visual con palabras clave de renderizado apiladas (cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime, semi-realistic CGI, hand-painted textures, Unreal Engine quality, film grain, hard-edge brushwork, heavy shadows) e incluye negativos explícitos (not cartoon, not Disney, not Pixar) para evitar la deriva de estilo.

fr.content:
Structurez votre prompt Seedance sous forme de shot list horodatée (par ex. 0:00–0:15) afin d’imposer une progression claire de l’action, beat par beat, et de réduire la dérive.

Utilisez une character sheet téléversée et indiquez explicitement « strict visual reference » pour verrouiller l’identité du personnage et la cohérence sur l’ensemble du clip.

Précisez d’emblée la durée du clip (par ex. 15 secondes) afin de contraindre le rythme et d’éviter que le modèle n’étire ou ne compresse la séquence.

Définissez le langage caméra pour chaque beat (wide/close/low-angle/tracking) et ajoutez « camera angles switching rapidly…never staying on one angle more than one second » pour obtenir un montage rapide en cuts.

Présentez les éléments du décor comme des outils/armes utilisables (bamboo poles, cement bags, ladders, rope pulleys, paint buckets, planks) afin de guider une chorégraphie de combat ancrée et lisible.

Pour des montages pilotés par l’audio, indiquez « music from frame one never stopping » et « every impact synced to the beat » afin d’aligner les impacts, les cuts et les effets sonores sur le rythme.

Verrouillez le style visuel avec des mots-clés de rendu empilés (cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime, semi-realistic CGI, hand-painted textures, Unreal Engine quality, film grain, hard-edge brushwork, heavy shadows) et ajoutez des négatifs explicites (not cartoon, not Disney, not Pixar) pour éviter toute dérive stylistique.

ja.content:
Seedance の prompt は、タイムコード付きの shot list（例: 0:00–0:15）として構成し、ビートごとの明確なアクション進行を強制して、drift を抑えます。

アップロードした character sheet を使用し、さらに “strict visual reference” と明記して、クリップ全体でキャラクターの同一性と一貫性を固定します。

クリップの長さを最初に指定し（例: 15 seconds）、ペース配分を制約して、モデルがシーケンスを引き伸ばしたり圧縮したりしないようにします。

ビートごとに camera language を定義し（wide/close/low-angle/tracking）、さらに “camera angles switching rapidly…never staying on one angle more than one second” を加えて、fast-cut の編集を促します。

環境内の小道具を使える道具／武器として明示し（bamboo poles, cement bags, ladders, rope pulleys, paint buckets, planks）、地に足のついた、読み取りやすい fight choreography を引き出します。

音楽主導の編集では、“music from frame one never stopping” と “every impact synced to the beat” を指示し、ヒット、カット、効果音をリズムに合わせます。

visual style は、重ねた render keywords（cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime, semi-realistic CGI, hand-painted textures, Unreal Engine quality, film grain, hard-edge brushwork, heavy shadows）で固定し、さらに明確な negatives（not cartoon, not Disney, not Pixar）を入れて、style drift を防ぎます。

ko.content:
Seedance prompt를 시간 코드가 있는 shot list 형식으로 구성하세요(예: 0:00–0:15). 이렇게 하면 비트마다 명확한 액션 진행이 강제되어 드리프트를 줄일 수 있습니다.

업로드한 character sheet를 사용하고, 캐릭터의 정체성과 클립 전반의 일관성을 고정하기 위해 “strict visual reference”라고 명시하세요.

클립 길이를 처음부터 분명히 지정하세요(예: 15 seconds). 이렇게 하면 pacing이 제한되고, 모델이 시퀀스를 늘리거나 압축하는 것을 방지할 수 있습니다.

비트마다 camera language를 정의하고(wide/close/low-angle/tracking), “camera angles switching rapidly…never staying on one angle more than one second”를 추가해 빠른 컷 편집을 유도하세요.

환경 소품을 사용할 수 있는 도구/무기(bamboo poles, cement bags, ladders, rope pulleys, paint buckets, planks)로 명시해 현실감 있고 읽기 쉬운 fight choreography를 유도하세요.

오디오 중심 편집의 경우, “music from frame one never stopping”과 “every impact synced to the beat”를 지시해 타격, 컷, sound effects가 리듬과 맞물리도록 하세요.

중첩된 render 키워드(cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime, semi-realistic CGI, hand-painted textures, Unreal Engine quality, film grain, hard-edge brushwork, heavy shadows)로 visual style을 고정하고, 스타일 드리프트를 방지하기 위해 명시적인 negatives(not cartoon, not Disney, not Pixar)를 포함하세요.

pt.content:
Estruture seu prompt do Seedance como uma shot list com marcação de tempo (por exemplo, 0:00–0:15) para forçar uma progressão clara de ação beat a beat e reduzir desvios.

Use uma character sheet enviada e diga explicitamente “strict visual reference” para travar a identidade e a consistência do personagem ao longo do clipe.

Especifique a duração do clipe logo no início (por exemplo, 15 seconds) para restringir o ritmo e evitar que o modelo estique ou comprima a sequência.

Defina a linguagem de câmera por beat (wide/close/low-angle/tracking) e adicione “camera angles switching rapidly…never staying on one angle more than one second” para conduzir uma edição em cortes rápidos.

Indique props do ambiente como ferramentas/armas utilizáveis (bamboo poles, cement bags, ladders, rope pulleys, paint buckets, planks) para solicitar uma coreografia de luta grounded e legível.

Para edições guiadas por áudio, instrua “music from frame one never stopping” e “every impact synced to the beat” para alinhar golpes, cortes e efeitos sonoros ao ritmo.

Trave o estilo visual com palavras-chave de renderização empilhadas (cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime, semi-realistic CGI, hand-painted textures, Unreal Engine quality, film grain, hard-edge brushwork, heavy shadows) e inclua negativos explícitos (not cartoon, not Disney, not Pixar) para evitar desvios de estilo.

zh.content:
将你的 Seedance prompt 结构化为带时间码的 shot list（例如 0:00–0:15），以强制清晰的逐拍动作推进并减少偏移。

使用上传的 character sheet，并明确写出“strict visual reference”，以锁定角色身份并确保整段 clip 的一致性。

提前指定 clip 时长（例如 15 seconds），以约束节奏，防止模型拉长或压缩序列。

按每个 beat 定义 camera language（wide/close/low-angle/tracking），并加入“camera angles switching rapidly…never staying on one angle more than one second”，以驱动快速剪辑。

将环境中的道具明确标注为可用工具/武器（bamboo poles, cement bags, ladders, rope pulleys, paint buckets, planks），以提示更扎实、易读的打斗编排。

对于受音乐驱动的剪辑，指示“music from frame one never stopping”和“every impact synced to the beat”，以让击打、切镜和音效与节奏对齐。

使用叠加的渲染关键词锁定视觉风格（cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime, semi-realistic CGI, hand-painted textures, Unreal Engine quality, film grain, hard-edge brushwork, heavy shadows），并加入明确的负面词（not cartoon, not Disney, not Pixar），以避免风格漂移。
